verdict.rationale: Evidence shows only that RSS campaigns send on a schedule and that the Marketing/Transactional APIs allow event-driven, API-triggered messages, which implies some autonomous background behavior, but there is no direct documentation of Mailchimp's automation/journey-builder feature or AI-native automation setup. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the Customer Journey/automation builder, evidence of AI-driven or agent-configurable automation setup, and independent confirmation that automations run reliably unattended.
